entries.fix: Put values in text and attribute values; bind behavior with `@verajs/directives`, or move the component to `@verajs/lite` or `@verajs/core`, which bind events and properties. An `<iframe>` is set through its attributes (`src`, `title`, `allow`): its content is fallback no browser shows. A `<noscript>` shows only with scripting off, when this tier never runs, so write it in the served page or render it with `@verajs/ssr`; one with no value inside renders here. (`@verajs/core` writes a value there as text.)

entries.message: {what} needs `@verajs/lite` or `@verajs/core`: `@verajs/static` renders markup once, so it does not work here (development says so; production renders nothing for it).
entries.fix: Bind behavior with `@verajs/directives`, or import the component from `@verajs/lite` or `@verajs/core`: the same source runs there.
